responsibility: Emits GCC’s BPF Type Format (.BTF) section from the per-translation-unit CTF container, reusing CTF type data but transforming it into BTF-specific records and layout. It owns the BTF output pipeline: section setup, CTF-kind to BTF-kind mapping, postprocessing of the collected type graph, synthesis of BTF-only records such as BTF_KIND_VAR, BTF_KIND_FUNC, and BTF_KIND_DATASEC, handling of void and other non-1:1 CTF/BTF mappings, adjustment of cross-type IDs through a CTF→BTF ID map, and final assembly emission of the BTF header, type records, variable/section records, and string table; it also resets all BTF-side state after emission.
